question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region_name,
        sr.name as rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
),
max_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(rep_sales) as max_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_reps AS (
    SELECT rs.region_name, rs.rep_name, rs.rep_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN max_sales ms ON rs.region_name = ms.region_name
    WHERE rs.rep_sales = ms.max_sales
),
region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region_name,
        COUNT(o.id) as order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.order_count,
    rs.total_sales,
    tr.rep_name,
    tr.rep_sales as top_rep_sales
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN top_reps tr ON rs.region_name = tr.region_name
ORDER BY rs.region_name
